description: src/holon_coherence/commands/ab_test.py leaks mkdtemp temporary directories in run_workload_ab_test, and pyproject.toml keeps an unused direct runtime dependency on cryptography==48.0.1.
goal: Fix temporary directory leaks in src/holon_coherence/commands/ab_test.py (keeping it strictly at or below 401 lines and NEVER modifying holon-config/hygiene/module_budgets.json) by replacing tempfile.mkdtemp calls in run_workload_ab_test with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory context managers so baseline and optimized wire directories are always cleaned up on normal exit or exception. Remove the unused direct 'cryptography==48.0.1' dependency from pyproject.toml and refresh uv.lock ('uv lock'). Add regression tests in tests/commands/test_ab_test.py verifying temp directories are removed even when workload execution raises. Use zero docstrings and zero comments in all modified files so tests/test_repo_self_doc.py passes, and NEVER modify holon-config/hygiene/module_budgets.json. Code is self-explaining: no docstrings and no comments except '# why:' comments that record a reason the code cannot show.
rationale: Leaked mkdtemp trace directories fill /tmp during benchmark loops, and unused direct dependencies bloat packaging and lockfiles unnecessarily.
acceptance_criteria: src/holon_coherence/commands/ab_test.py uses tempfile.TemporaryDirectory cleanly in run_workload_ab_test and stays at most 401 lines without touching holon-config/hygiene/module_budgets.json.
pyproject.toml omits 'cryptography==48.0.1' and uv.lock stays valid under 'uv sync --locked --check' or 'uv lock --check'.
tests/commands/test_ab_test.py proves temporary wire directories are deleted after success or failure with zero docstrings or comments, and 'uv run pytest' plus 'uv run task lint' pass.
